// PROBE — must turn tests/unit/email-normalization-single-path.test.ts RED.
// A writer keyed on an email that never went through normalizeEmail.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function addPhantom(email: string, name: string) {
    let user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email } })
    if (!user) {
        user = await db.user.create({ data: { email, name, roles: "policyholder" } })
    }
    return user.id
}
